protocol.tau_status: zero boundary diagnostic only; not optimized
protocol.signal: long: beta[t]<0 and g[t-1]<=0 and g[t]>0; short mirror; both g observations finite; strict zero, no epsilon, no zero carry for g crossings
protocol.g: OLS of five beta values; [-2,-1,0,1,2]/10; use unscaled beta for event calculation
protocol.cycle: maximal beta sign run; exact beta zero retains last nonzero cycle sign; first observed run left-truncated; all warmup events counted for ordinal before performance filtering
protocol.confirmation: first strictly opposite beta sign after event; zero alone not confirmation; signal observed and next-open execution availability distinguished
protocol.outcomes: interval from next-open actual hypothetical entry to first executable confirmation next-open; if no executable confirmation, mark at final training close, no synthetic exit fee; report censored separately
protocol.excursions: slipped entry anchor; include entry bar through bar before confirmation execution; include exit raw open endpoint, exclude exit candle high/low; training-censored includes last candle high/low and final close; clamp MAE/MFE at zero; no invented intrabar order
protocol.fixed_horizon_use: description only, not holding-period optimization; all events with endpoint inside training, unavailable endpoints retained in availability counts
protocol.first_vs_later: ordinal within complete sign-cycle event history, including warmup; no best-event selection; period-boundary truncated cycles flagged
protocol.background: all valid same-sign-beta bars, same next-open costs and horizons; overlapping descriptive comparison, not independent controls or executable portfolio
protocol.winner_diagnostic: original OLS N64 top10 closed net winners, preceding beta sign cycle; compare all events and first event without hindsight choice; no modified-trade PnL claim

data.holdout_usage: snapshot structural QC only; 2022/2023 removed before indicators/execution/metrics
data.policy: zero-volume records retained unchanged; no forward fill or price imputation

baseline_gate.direction_cost_and_metrics: all independently matched at 1e-6 absolute tolerance

interpretation: event counts not trade counts; overlapping outcomes not summed; future confirmation used only to describe outcomes, never select events
